central_value_note: Use raw network sigma as the quoted central value for real SDSS unless a domain-specific central-value calibration has been validated. The global affine mapping is retained for diagnostics/error calibration only.

training_label_range.note: Inference reports whether a real spectrum lands outside or near the trained sigma label range.

real_sdss_quality_cuts.golden_sample_definition: grade A, above the high-confidence resolution threshold, with acceptable decomposition/reconstruction diagnostics, and not near the training-label floor/ceiling
real_sdss_quality_cuts.note: For real SDSS spectra this is a measurement-quality flag, not an extra training/test metric. The real-SDSS error gate is allowed to be looser than the mock lowest-uncertainty gate and is then constrained by the empirical risk model.

real_sdss_error_model.note: Use these as additional floors for real SDSS inference, on top of validation-calibrated mock uncertainty.

quality_risk_model.note: Nearest-neighbor empirical risk model trained only on the mock validation split.
